description: Initiative 0002 Slice 4: deterministically match B-II exception items to instrument PDFs for pack_01_clean and surface missing-doc journey for pack_02_missing_rea, using item-level match_status and locked citations (no silent auto-pick).

userStories.title: Match exceptions to instrument PDFs (clean pack)
userStories.description: Match exception items to instruments deterministically, attach evidence citations supporting the match, and surface ambiguity explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_01_clean, exception items with truth-linked instruments resolve to match_status=matched.
Each matched item includes citations supporting the match (instrument no/recording reference).
If >1 candidate matches, item is match_status=ambiguous with candidates listed (no silent auto-pick).

userStories.title: Surface missing-doc journey (pack_02_missing_rea)
userStories.description: When an exception references a missing instrument doc, show match_status=missing_doc with an actionable checklist including expected filename.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_02_missing_rea, missing REA is surfaced as match_status=missing_doc for the relevant items.
Row notes include an actionable checklist and include the expected filename when known (e.g. REA.pdf).
Row status uses missing_input only when an answer truly cannot be supported; otherwise row remains needs_review with item-level missing states.
